rdf:Description.dc:title: 82 Kirkland Street, Cambridge, MA
rdf:Description.dc:description: Roy lived at 82 Kirkland Street while in graduate school at Harvard. For those of us who knew him then, it was a special place and an important destination, full of good conversation, fun and friendship.
